## Notes and caveats

  products: This domain publishes product identity only -- id and name. Category, role, status, decision, publication state and every other catalogue field are deliberately not loaded.
  costing: Batch yield and target food cost are parsed from the free-text costing.notes column; no dedicated column exists for either, so both are reported as inferred.
  costing: Costing review timestamps are only reliable from 2026-08-07T18:32:04Z; earlier rows report reviewedAt as unknown rather than substituting their creation time.
  costing: sourceAsOf is the most recent costing record creation time, not a review time.
  inventory: Expiration and stock states are anchored to 2026-08-09 in Asia/Manila, not to UTC.
  inventory: Ingredients whose unit could not be migrated are reported as a data-integrity signal, and any inventory valuation that would include them is reported as unknown.
  inventory: Purchase-import staging rows, ingredient aliases, and ledger actor names are deliberately excluded.
  readiness: Supply-category results are insufficient_data because the Supplies domain is not part of this milestone -- not because the business lacks purchase history.
  readiness: Selling Format data is not loaded in this milestone, so QUAL-002 reports insufficient_data for scope reasons rather than as a finding about packaging.
  readiness: QUAL-001/002/003/005 are evaluated by keyword search over free text; their provenance is marked inferred and they must not be read as strongly as arithmetic checks.
  readiness: Launch composite gates are not evaluated: includeLaunch is false, matching the Rule Engine's own default for routine evaluation.

## What this snapshot does not know

  10 of 15 declared domains have no adapter: batches, sellingFormats, tasting, supplies, equipment, journey, opportunities, creative, brand, aiReviews.
